key_points: Smooth frame delivery can coexist with higher input latency.
Qualcomm input boost is explicitly coupled to touchscreen events and cpufreq policy updates.
Frequent scheduler-context cpufreq work can add overhead; rate limiting exists to control it.
Objective Perfetto android_input_events and FrameTimeline should be used for A/B.
Xiaomi donor defers package history roll and exposes pause_mode; Candidate0059 differs in WALT hot-path semantics.

primary_hypotheses.hypothesis: Candidate0059 package-runtime/WALT hot path performs unnecessary shared user history writes compared with donor semantics, increasing tail latency.
Candidate0059 MIGT FREQ_QOS activity interferes with Qualcomm touch/input boost timing or adds redundant scheduler/cpufreq work.
Goodix IRQ delivery/affinity/rate is abnormal under Candidate0059.
TouchFeature HwBinder -74 contributes materially to the regression.
